Identity and cache keys of an nlmixr2 fit

Source: R/fitkey.R
nlmixr2saveFitIdentity.Rd

nlmixr2saveFitIdentity() identifies which fit this is: the model, the estimation method, the estimates and the data. It is the same for a fit, its saveFit()/loadFit() reload, and the fit after addCwres().

Usage

nlmixr2saveFitIdentity(fit)

nlmixr2saveFitKey(fit, sha = TRUE)

Arguments

fit

An nlmixr2 fit.

sha

Include nlmixr2save's own := fields (nlmixr2save, nlmixr2saveOrig)?

Value

A list suitable for hashing.

Details

nlmixr2saveFitKey() additionally changes whenever something a downstream result could depend on changes: added table columns (addCwres(), addNpde(), addTable()), objective function rows (setOfv()), the covariance (preconditionFit()) or the table values. := hashes fits on its right-hand side with this key, so a result built on a fit reloaded in a new session is still a cache hit.

Neither key forces or writes anything in the fit.
